gaps.title: No real‑time temperature & humidity monitoring
gaps.detail: Cold Chain 3PL offers temperature‑controlled storage and transport but does not mention IoT sensors for live temperature, humidity, or location tracking, leaving a blind spot for product integrity.
gaps.based_on: Cold Chain 3PL provides temperature‑controlled storage, handling, and transportation for perishable food, pharmaceutical products, and frozen goods.

gaps.title: Lack of unified IoT dashboard for multi‑site compliance
gaps.detail: While an advanced order management system provides inventory visibility, there is no unified platform that consolidates sensor data across global warehouses and trucks for instant alerts and audit‑ready reports.
gaps.based_on: Cold Chain 3PL integrated an advanced order management system with real‑time inventory tracking, automated order processing...

gaps.title: Limited automated regulatory compliance support
gaps.detail: Cold Chain 3PL scales across many temperature‑controlled facilities but lacks automated tools for emerging pharma and food traceability regulations (e.g., Schedule M, FSSAI), which can be costly to manage manually.
gaps.based_on: Cold Chain 3PL emphasizes scalability, offering a flexible network of global, temperature‑controlled warehouses to handle seasonal demand spikes.

pitch.angle:
- You’ve built a strong 20‑year fulfillment network; adding IoT temperature sensors guarantees product integrity in real time and cuts spoilage.
- Our ThinxFresh platform unifies sensor data from every warehouse and truck into one dashboard, delivering instant deviation alerts and auto‑generated compliance reports.
- With emerging Schedule M and FSSAI traceability mandates, automated audit logs keep you audit‑ready without extra effort.
- Asset trackers on your fleet extend visibility beyond carrier partnerships, further reducing shipping delays.
pitch.opener: I see Cold Chain 3PL’s 20‑year expertise in temperature‑controlled fulfillment—let’s explore how real‑time IoT monitoring can protect every pallet you ship.
